{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.109","title":"room-policy §5: say who removes a user from a parent-dependent room","description":"Mark 2026-11-23: "i also sounds like room-policy §5 has a mistake that
needs to be PRed". Found while deciding mimid-1wgh.111.

THE TEXT, room-policy-04 §5: "If a user leaves or is removed from the
parent room, that user is automatically removed from any parent-dependent
rooms of that parent."

THE MISTAKE. Passive voice, no actor, and the only party that sees the
parent change cannot do it. Removing a user from a room is a Commit in
that room's MLS group, and only a member of the group can send one. A Hub
is not a member (mimid's hub/operator.rs says so plainly). So §5 as
written requires an action no specified party can perform, and a reader
implementing it finds no way to.

It is not only editorial: the timing is a security property. A
parent-dependent room's exported secret is what draft-atwood-mimi-calls
keys a call from, so the gap between the parent change and the child
Commit is a window in which a departed user still derives the call's
media secret. §5 as written says there is no window.

PREPARED LOCALLY, NOT POSTED: ~/PROJECT/mimi-room-policy branch
cascade-needs-a-committer, commit 4b0d277, off main rather than off the
#59 branch so the two changes stay separable. It names the actor and the
timing in four lines:

  If a user leaves or is removed from the parent room, that user MUST
  also be removed from any parent-dependent rooms of that parent.
  A removal from a room is a Commit in its MLS group, which only a member
  of that group can send, so a Hub that is not a member cannot perform
  the removal itself.
  Such a Hub proposes the removal instead, and it takes effect when a
  member of the parent-dependent room next commits.
  Until then the departed user is still a member of that room, and can
  still derive secrets its MLS group exports.

NEEDS MARK'S OK to push, to open the PR, and to file the issue that goes
with it, as every upstream post does. No JMAP in either (memory
no-jmap-to-the-mimi-wg).
